articles.title: Boost for Navy's defence: India successfully tests long-range hypersonic anti-ship missile off Odisha
articles.summary: India successfully tested a long-range hypersonic anti-ship missile off the Odisha coast, marking a significant boost for the Indian Navy's defence capabilities. This achievement enhances the Navy's ability to counter maritime threats and demonstrates India's advanced indigenous missile technology. The successful trial strengthens India's naval prowess, crucial for maintaining security and strategic balance in the region.

articles.title: India eases HVDC localisation rules, sets timeline to reach 60% local content by 2035
articles.summary: The Ministry of Power has updated "Make in India" procurement norms, establishing a phased roadmap to achieve 60% minimum local content in HVDC substations. This move aims to significantly boost domestic manufacturing capabilities within the power sector, reduce reliance on imports, and enhance national self-reliance for critical infrastructure projects, fostering economic growth and job creation.
